home.hero_title: BE EQUIPPED. BE TRANSFORMED. BE SENT.
home.hero_support: Complete your registration and you'll be directed straight to our official WhatsApp Training Community.
home.about_body: The God Nation Media & Leadership Academy exists to leverage modern media to make the Gospel of the Kingdom accessible in every nation — developing and deploying leaders who multiply disciples through scalable digital systems.
home.training_body: Join a dedicated WhatsApp Training Community where you'll grow in discipleship, receive guidance, and connect with leaders equipping you for Kingdom impact.
home.benefit_3: Content delivered in English or French
home.benefit_4: Free to join — built for everyone, everywhere
home.how_1_body: Share your name and WhatsApp number — it takes less than a minute.
home.how_2_body: You're instantly directed to the right WhatsApp Training Community for your language.
home.how_3_body: Learn, connect, and be equipped to make disciples in your own context.
